limits: Distances use a local WGS84 azimuthal-equidistant projection centred at each queried centre, without modifying source polygons.
The 100m grouping is descriptive context for published LSIB accuracy language, not a qualification threshold, guaranteed error bound or source applicability decision.
USCB source metadata cites LSIB accessed2022; these distances do not assert equality with current2025 LSIB.
A centre on the CAF side of a named provider border does not by itself erase an authenticated foreign source or prove commune identity.
